An exemption is a DATED, ATTRIBUTED admission that a scorecard artifact exists whose ledger handoff row never landed -- never a convenience. Key every entry by DATE, because the violation is per date (an artifact date with no self-audit run/score row) and the artifact file is named after it; each entry names why the row is missing and states the EMPTY REPAIR SPACE. The ledger is append-only and `append` has no `--ts`, so a retro row cannot carry the day's true stamp: re-stamping a day's handoff after the fact would falsify the record. Each entry is printed as an `excused:` line on EVERY gate run -- visible debt, not forgiveness. A malformed entry, an entry for a date that DOES carry a row (STALE), and an entry for a date with no artifact (PHANTOM) are each a gate FAILURE rather than a silent pass.
